card.name: Linking word after animal fetal-harm findings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as at, with, when or was right after a named fetal harm finding (malformations, fetal loss, growth changes) in animal pregnancy study summaries. The next words usually give the dose or exposure level.

modes.label: at after finding

modes.label: with or when after finding
modes.description: With or when follows a fetal harm outcome and leads into a condition or accompanying effect.
modes.example: In animal reproduction studies, osimertinib caused post-implantation fetal loss<< when>> administered during early development at a dose exposure
